name: DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age – Definitive Edition

achievements.name: Coming of Age
achievements.detail: Finish the coming-of-age ascent above Cobblestone and depart the village.

achievements.name: Heliodor Escape
achievements.detail: Break out of the Heliodor dungeon with Erik.

achievements.name: Twin Companions
achievements.detail: Bring both Veronica and Serena into the party.

achievements.name: Sand National
achievements.detail: Win a horse race on the track at Gallopolis.

achievements.name: Clear Skies
achievements.detail: Stop the endless rain hanging over the canals of Gondolia.

achievements.name: Octagonia Open
achievements.detail: Win the fighting tournament held in Octagonia.

achievements.name: Fun-Size Forge
achievements.detail: Rework a piece of equipment on the Fun-Size Forge at camp.

achievements.name: Pep Power
achievements.detail: Unleash a pep power while members of the party are pepped up.

achievements.name: Salty Stallion
achievements.detail: Board the Salty Stallion and sail from one land to another.

achievements.name: Classic Mode
achievements.detail: Fight a battle after switching the adventure into 2D mode.

achievements.name: Yggdrasil
achievements.detail: Reach Yggdrasil, the great tree the Luminary set out to find.

achievements.name: Sword of Light
achievements.detail: Forge the Sword of Light with the Forging Hammer and orichalcum.

achievements.name: Last Battle
achievements.detail: Defeat the foe that still remains after the credits roll.
